messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Very shocked when i saw him alive as i remember his son very upset about it.

output.original_text: Very shocked when i saw him alive as i remember his son very upset about it.
output.joy: I was overjoyed to see him alive, especially remembering how upset his son was!
output.sadness: It was heartbreaking to see him alive, knowing how devastated his son had been.
output.fear: I was terrified to see him alive, thinking about how upset his son must have been.
output.anger: Seeing him alive shocked me, especially since I recall how furious his son was about everything.
output.surprise: I was completely stunned to see him alive, especially after how upset his son had been!
output.disgust: I felt sickened to see him alive, recalling how his son had been so upset over it.
